name: Sanebara Maki
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Maki is a member of the school's Arts and Crafts club.
She is so calm and unfussy, it takes her three times the time it takes a normal human to react to anything. Due to this, she is immune to anything. If something bad happens she is smiling sincerely, healing mentally the people around her. 
There are no human beings who have ever seen her face of astonishment, impatience, or horror. However, she can cry, even when she is impressed by little things. This helps people to approach her more easily.
